comparison.objective: Lower a gas-spring overbed table to a marked height and lock it; candidate sets a gripper opening stop and locks it.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a release paddle while overcoming gas-spring force, then release in a safe order versus coaxial driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Marked height held hands-free without rebound, tilt, or shin force versus 90° opening retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: This is a close set-and-lock pattern, but its force-control mechanism and tested functional outcome differ meaningfully from jam-nut setting preservation.
